title: Mystic Fleur-de-lis Crystal
description: A glowing crystal ball sits on an ornate dark pedestal decorated with golden fleur-de-lis symbols. Inside the sphere, a large golden fleur-de-lis emblem emits intense purple, blue, and cyan magical energy tendrils that connect to five floating purple slot-machine reel strips and a glowing blue hand on the right.
prompt: A dark ornate crystal ball on a gothic pedestal with golden fleur-de-lis emblems, inside it a large glowing golden fleur-de-lis radiates powerful magical energy. Five purple slot machine reels with symbols float around it connected by bright purple, blue and cyan lightning-like energy streams. A glowing blue hand reaches toward the sphere from the right. Candles and scattered gems on a cloth-covered table in a dark gothic interior, dramatic magical lighting, cinematic fantasy style.
